description: Uva Provincial Council - Uva Provincial  Council Statute No. 05 of 2017 of Uva Navodaya Fund (Amendment)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment and publication of a provincial statute (Uva Provincial Council Statute No. 05 of 2017) that amends an existing fund. It establishes a legal framework for the Uva Navodaya Fund, defines its administrative structure, powers, duties, and purposes. This falls under "New laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "Statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation" as defined in the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions government positions (e.g., Chief Minister, Education Minister), these are part of the statutory framework defining the fund's board composition, not the primary focus of a personnel or structural government announcement.
